title: Volume 1 Chapter 3: Fubuki Azuma's Arc 2
content: Yuki and Himari engaged in rigorous combat against the professionals in the training area.
Thanks to the training Kyouka usually provided, Yuki was pleased that he could keep up with the training.
Having little experience in hand-to-hand combat, this match was very informative for him.
"I had a great training session right away. Yuki, you were making sharp movements."
Thanks to getting used to Kyouka-san, the opponent's movements felt slow to me.
Even though they weren't at all.
Anyway, it was great.
After resting for a while, Toka Azuma and Maika Azuma approached the two.
"Hey, you two. Good to see you. Make sure to train hard."
"I have various questions about abilities. Maika, Toka."
"You should use honorifics with your sister and grandmother, Himari."
"Ha ha ha. You're cheeky. Well, I'll let it slide since you're with your boyfriend."
Yuki was patted on the cheek and head by Toka, who then peered into his eyes.
"You're in good health, kid. Quite good."
"By the way, I didn't fight Himari during the Evening Banquet."
Himari, being sisters with Himari, quickly understood what Maika wanted to say.
"What? You want to fight me, Maika?"
"Yes. Since Yachiho and Homare lost to Himari, I will show what it means to be an older sister."
"Bring it on."
"Agreed. Just one match, no continuations."
"Hey, is this okay, Himari?"
"This will be a valuable experience; you need to pile up battles."
"That's right. It's something that will benefit you, so I suggested it."
"This isn't about a falling out or a fight."
"Sounds like a good flow. I've heard enough, so I'll officiate this."
"Please do, Toka Azuma."
I'll heal you if you get hurt.
Go all out.
The place should be an alternate space where abilities can be fully utilized.
Toka took Yuki's hand and led him.
That gesture reminded him of Fubuki, evoking a sense of parent-child connection.
"Come on, this way, this way. You all should know the drill by now."
The Azuma household had a door leading to an alternate space created by the abilities of its members.
They all moved to that deserted island-like space.
Here, they could unleash their abilities without worrying about collateral damage.
While the ability to create a unique space was quite special, there were several users of such abilities within the specialist group of the Anti-Demon Corps.
Waruwara Pilipenko, the commander of the 8th Squad, was one of them.
"Yuki, I'll fight using the Slave ability. I can't use other abilities at a practical level yet."
"Got it."
"Maika, just like during the Evening Banquet, I'll fight alongside Yuki. Is that alright?"
"Feel free. It's rude to tell a dog trainer not to use their dog."
"Sounds like something Yachiho would say."
"Is that so? You two are like sisters, hee hee hee."
"Why are you so happy about that?"
Himari activated Kyouka's "Slave" ability through her copying ability.
Himari whispered to Yuki.
"Yuki, aim for the gaps between the fingers of the hand guarding Maika and slip in a knife hand."
"I thought of that too. It feels a bit awkward, though."
With a recovery specialist around, don't hesitate.
The opponent won't hold back either.
Your current hesitation isn't kindness; it's softness.
Go for it.
A sharp reprimand came from her master.
"Understood, I'm going for it!"
Yuki closed the distance to Maika in a straight line, moving from the circular motion he had been using to evade.
Following his master's orders, he unleashed a powerful knife hand toward Maika.
However, the gap he aimed for closed swiftly.
"You've fallen for it."
A massive shockwave surged from behind Yuki, who had his knife hand blocked.
"Ugh!"
An invisible slap struck Yuki directly.
"I thought you would aim for the gap between my fingers. So, I just had to cover that area."
"Using the invisible hand for attacks was just at the start, huh?"
"That's right. After that, I had it waiting right next to me."
Yuki assessed his own damage.
Himari's whirlwind form increased speed and jumping ability but decreased strength and stamina.
(Alright. I can still fight.)
The hand that attacked had used energy to become invisible, so its destructive power was considerably reduced.
"Himari, I have no choice but to use this."
"Yes, that's the only breakthrough I can see."
The "Slave" ability has a mode called "Tenshin" that significantly boosts power for a limited time.
If he used Tenshin, the fatigue would be severe, and if he didn't decide the match there, it would become quite difficult.
"I'm going!"
"Tenshin!!"
Just as Yuki was about to change his form, one of the giant fists charged in, spinning.
This time, the attack was visible.
If it hit directly, Yuki in whirlwind form could be taken down in one hit.
"Ha ha! Maika is still as uncooperative as ever."
"The trick of Tenshin is already known. Did you think I would let you use it so easily?"
"That's right, especially against Shuki; they won't wait."
Yuki barely managed to dodge the roaring fist.
However, the moment he dodged, the fist opened from a closed position to a palm.
Yuki's body was struck by the suddenly extended fingers.
Rolling on the ground, Yuki and Himari were separated.
As Yuki struggled to stand, the attacking hand firmly grasped him.
"I've got you."
As always, the other hand was solidly guarding Maika.
"Uooooo!!"
Yuki strained to shake off the grasping hand.
"That's a futile struggle."
However, the grip was stronger than his resistance.
Himari shot at Maika with the gun she had.
But of course, that gunfire was blocked by the hand that was on defense.
In Himari's case, once it gets to this point, her main body can't do anything, which is a weakness.
If it were Kyouka, her main body would launch fierce attacks.
"Is that so?"
At that moment, Maika realized.
The chain that Yuki had extended was reaching out.
And the extended chain reached Himari's hand.
"The gunfire was a decoy."
"That's right, it's too late now, this time it's Tenshin!!"
Yuki began to glow.
"You managed to extend the chain that long. Impressive."
"I noticed quickly; you were just a little slow to realize. You're too soft, Maika."
"I'll just respond with combat suited for Tenshin."
With a twist, Yuki transformed into his Tenshin form.
"Ah, as expected, that form is brimming with power."
"Even though it's a speed-focused form, you have more strength than my hand."
Maika quickly released the hand that had been holding Yuki.
Yuki charged at Maika at super speed, thrusting forward.
That sharp attack broke through the hand protecting Maika.
However, the advance was halted.
The other hand was already guarding Maika.
"Ugh, it's so tough."
Instead of returning the hand, it's faster to release it and reappear right in front of you.
It's a technique often used in manga and games.
"I'll push through!"
Yuki unleashed a storm of punches toward Maika.
"That's useless."
Even the destroyed hand quickly regenerated to a like-new state, preventing Yuki from reaching Maika.
"I can't break through...!!"
I always choose characters with high stamina and defense in games.
I solidify my guard and maneuver carefully, and in the end, I seize victory.
Maika was like that since she was a child.
She's excellent, but I think her personality is more suited to being an assistant than a leader.
The head of the Azuma must be grand.
"Ugh, Maika, you're aiming for our time limit."
"Yes, enhancements like Tenshin come with a time limit. When you're exhausted, I'll smack you with my hand."
"Even though that should tire you out too...!"
"It's easier for me than it is for you."
"Maika. Watching a war of attrition is boring."
"But winning is the most important thing, right, Toka Azuma?"
"That's right. In the Azuma family, winning is the most important thing."
"Yuki, concentrate all your remaining strength and break through."
"That's the only option! If this continues, I'll wear out and lose!"
"Wait!"
A clear voice echoed across the battlefield.
Fubuki Azuma, having finished her work, returned from Mato.
"Fubuki. The match is still ongoing."
"This match will be declared a draw at my discretion."
Fubuki Azuma, who had arrived in the alternate space, interrupted the match.
"What? I was worried about the conflict between family, but can we not do this?"
"Himari and Maika are both vice commanders. There's no need to go out of our way to determine a winner."
"I wanted to demonstrate the dignity of an older sister."
"Himari, do you think Maika lacks dignity?"
"Eh, w-what's with the sudden question?"
"Answer me."
"She consistently produces results and supports well. Maika has dignity, doesn't she?"
"Himari..."
"Then there’s no reason to fight."
"I understand."
"Tch, you’re still so obedient to your parents. Yuki, that's enough for now."
"I think being overly protective is questionable, but I suppose I’ll follow the head's orders."
"Thanks for being so quick to understand, Mother."
"This fight wasn't instigated by me."
"I understand."
Himari released Yuki from his transformation.
In any case, since he had advanced, his power was insufficient to maintain the transformation.
"I have something to do, so you go ahead."
Himari began to usher her relatives out.
"It’s a reward, right? I don’t mind, go ahead."
"That’s not how it works! Ah, come on, my body is acting on its own."
Himari approached Yuki and wrapped her arms around his neck.
Then, as usual, she kissed him.
"Fuhaha, what a fresh kiss."
"Don’t look at me!"
"Himari, focus on the reward."
In a situation where her mother and grandmother were watching the kiss, Himari was blushing more than usual.
As for Maika, she wiped her glasses and watched Himari's kiss intently.
"Hehehe. This is getting quite fun."
Saying that, Kamairika began to stroke Yuki's rear with her hand.
"Uh, Kamairika-san?"
"I told you before, feel free to call me Kamairika-chan, kid."
"I can’t do that."
"I permit it. I’m kind to the young."
More accurately, you’re kind to young men, right, Mother?
What if a rookie from the Anti-Demon Corps called you Kamairika-chan?
"Of course, I’d give them a punch. But I let my high school girl friends call me Kamairika-chan."
"Seriously."
"Wakura Yuki, shall I spoil you as well?"
As she said this, Kamairika began to scratch Yuki's pants with her fingertips.
"I-I’m fine."
What’s with the embarrassment?
Or is it because I’m Himari’s grandmother that you dislike it?
Don’t worry about age; I’m not pretending to be young.
I actually became younger.
For example, if there’s a person with the ability to reverse that, even if I were to absorb their ability, I’d still look like this.
Understand?
The youth is a settled effect.
"S-So?"
I’m just like a young student.
Fresh like just-caught fish.
I’m like the 1st Squad's high school girl captain.
Feel free to fall for me.
As if a living creature was entwining Yuki's hand, Kamairika held it tightly.
"The 1st Squad captain wouldn’t suddenly start groping someone, Mother."
"That’s my personality. You can touch too, Wakura Yuki, come on."
However, thinking about it, Yuki was surprised that Kamairika seemed to have no concept of lifespan.
He recalled Izumo Tenka’s comment about whether Kamairika was human or demon.
"Why are you barging in? This isn’t your business."
"Himari, focus on your reward and give it your all."
"Thanks to you two, I can’t concentrate!"
"Mother, please stop it."
"What? Aren’t we all gathered here to enjoy ourselves?"
"What kind of thinking is that, seriously?"
Saying this, Himari resumed the kiss.
"Relax, it’s okay."
Whispered Fubuki, who was close to Yuki's ear.
Yuki was flustered by Fubuki's allure.
"Hehehe, so cute."
"Yeah."
This time, Kamairika and Fubuki looked at Yuki with affectionate eyes.
That was embarrassing for Yuki.
The strong-willed Himari firmly fixed Yuki's chin with both hands and pushed her slick tongue into his mouth.
Yuki was astonished by Himari's boldness.
The rewards from kissing Himari could last ten or even twenty minutes.
There were also variations where the kisses would move to different places after starting.
Although he was getting through the numbers, Yuki hesitated slightly at the thought of being seen by others.
However, Himari steeled herself and somehow managed to complete the reward.
After the training ended, it was time for a break inside the Azuma household.
Himari clung to Kamairika, saying she had questions about her abilities.
"We’ve been given a break, but what should we do?"
Although he had been assigned a room for himself, Yuki thought it would be a waste of time to just sleep.
He walked alone through the vast Azuma household.
The seemingly endless corridors might indeed have some kind of ability activated.
"What’s wrong? Lost or something?"
Azuma Maika, who had just been fighting Himari, called out to Yuki, who was alone.
"I was given a break, but I’m wondering how to spend it."
"Ah, I see. Himari is with Kamairika-sama, right?"
Maika's eyes fixed intently on Yuki.
"Wakura Yuki. Can you play games?"
"Games, like board games or tabletop games? Or are you talking about…"
"Video games."
"Yes, I can do that."
"How good are you?"
For example, in fighting games, my friends told me to ban Kyle.
Oh, I guess that doesn’t make sense out of nowhere.
Kyle is from a game called Street Fighter.
Which series of Kyle are you good at?
Most series have him ranked high.
You’re not talking about the live-action version, are you?
Yuki was taken aback by the unexpectedly intense response.
"If you can play games, would you like to play with me a bit?"
"Y-Yes. Maika-san seems strong."
"Somewhat."
(This kind of person saying "somewhat" definitely means they’re really strong.)
Guided by Maika, Yuki entered her room and was astonished by the surroundings.
(The gaming setup is terrifyingly well-equipped!)
The PC and chair looked like something a professional would use in a stream.
"What shall we compete in? There are other games besides Street Fighter."
"Oh, I can play Samurai Spirits too."
There are also Playcarz, Fallen Archangel, Waku Waku 8, Ashura Blade, Last Bronx, Psychic Force, Toblerone Number One, Kikai Mao, and more.
If Yuki said something careless about games, he would receive an overwhelmingly dense response, making him hesitate.
"L-Let’s have a match in the latest Street Fighter."
"Good."
Yuki had played this game with Shushu occasionally in the 7th Squad.
Shushu was quite good at games, so he had some confidence in his skills.
However.
"S-Strong… I give up."
Shushu's skill was only good among friends.
But Maika's level was on a completely different scale, and Yuki lost without being able to do anything.
"Shall we switch to something else? How about a cooperative game?"
Maika chose an FPS game where they would team up to fight.
"Oh, sorry Maika-san, I need your support right now."
"No, you’re doing good. Now let’s move over here."
With Maika providing support, Yuki was able to enjoy the game.
He managed to win a championship in a competitive game.
"Does everyone in the Azuma household play games together?"
"Honor does it somewhat. Kamairika-sama plays a little too. The others don’t at all."
"Kamairika-san plays games too?"
"When she loses, her mood visibly darkens, so I have to be careful."
Yuki could easily imagine that scene and couldn’t help but laugh.
Next, he tried playing a racing game with Maika, but she was also good at this.
Maika taught him some tips, and Yuki was happy to see his skills improve.
In this manner, Maika calmly escorted Yuki.
(Cool and impressive, Maika-san.)
Yuki was able to enjoy his break time.
